lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tl6Al2 (reduced formula Tl3Al) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 216), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 14 geometric neighbors (10 Tl, 4 Al) and Tl centers with either 9 neighbors (5 Al, 4 Tl) or 14 neighbors (8 Al, 6 Tl), with a three-dimensional geometric neighbor graph spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Al and Tl coordination polyhedra, and edge- and corner- or face-sharing among like-centered Al and Tl polyhedra.
